actionConfiguration.body:
-- Appsmith query getQueue (Queue page). Each filter is a multi-select; nothing selected = no filter.
-- The selections arrive as one comma-separated string (a prepared-statement parameter, never
-- pasted into the SQL), and string_to_array turns them back into a list.
WITH f AS (
  SELECT string_to_array({{ filterStatus.selectedOptionValues.join(',') }}, ',')     AS statuses,
         string_to_array({{ filterDepartment.selectedOptionValues.join(',') }}, ',') AS departments
)
SELECT q.request_id,
       CASE
         WHEN request_is_open(q.status) THEN q.sla_label
         WHEN q.status = 'Cancelled'    THEN '—'
         WHEN q.sla_status = 'BREACHED' THEN '🔴 MISSED'
         ELSE '✅ MET'
       END AS sla,
       q.status,
       q.priority,
       q.department,
       q.category,
       q.title,
       q.description,
       q.requester_name,
       q.requester_email,
       q.assignee,
       to_char(q.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_tehran,
       to_char(q.due_at     AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS due_tehran
FROM v_request_queue q, f
WHERE (cardinality(f.statuses) = 0    OR q.status     = ANY (f.statuses))
  AND (cardinality(f.departments) = 0 OR q.department = ANY (f.departments))
ORDER BY request_is_open(q.status) DESC, q.due_at;

-- Appsmith query updateRequest (Queue page), run by the Save button in the details panel.
-- svc_app may only change status, assignee and priority; the table's trigger stamps
-- updated_at and sets or clears resolved_at when the status closes or reopens a request.
UPDATE service_request
SET status   = {{ updStatus.selectedOptionValue }},
    assignee = NULLIF(btrim({{ updAssignee.text }}), '')
WHERE request_id = {{ tblQueue.selectedRow.request_id }}
RETURNING request_id, status, assignee, resolved_at;

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE request_is_open(status))                             AS open_requests,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE request_is_open(status) AND sla_status = 'AT_RISK')  AS at_risk,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE request_is_open(status) AND sla_status = 'BREACHED') AS breached,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Completed', 'Resolved') AND sla_status <> 'BREACHED')
                   / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Completed', 'Resolved')), 0), 1) AS sla_met_pct
FROM v_request_queue;

SELECT department,
       count(*)                                                                    AS total,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE request_is_open(status))                             AS open,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE request_is_open(status) AND sla_status = 'BREACHED') AS breached_open,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Completed', 'Resolved'))                 AS delivered,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Completed', 'Resolved') AND sla_status <> 'BREACHED')
                   / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Completed', 'Resolved')), 0), 1) AS sla_met_pct,
       round(avg(extract(epoch FROM resolved_at - created_at) / 3600)
               FILTER (WHERE status IN ('Completed', 'Resolved')), 1)              AS avg_hours_to_deliver
FROM v_request_queue
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY department;

SELECT to_char(occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS occurred_tehran,
       workflow_name, node_name, error_message, execution_url
FROM workflow_error_log
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT category, count(*) AS requests
FROM service_request
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY requests DESC;
